set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H04.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Performance/backend engineer
Scope: Close measured hot paths and resource failures against the frozen engineering profile.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H04 (bd-01M4X8M9GWYPFKAAZVHK760RSN)
Suggested delivery tranche: T4; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Execute repeated cold/warm profile runs and retain request distributions, throughput, process memory, DB work/plans, storage and queue/stream occupancy including authorization/serialization cost.
2. Fix every mandatory-budget failure with targeted regression evidence; demonstrate that slow clients, concurrent imports/exports and history growth cannot starve ordinary discovery or escape configured resource bounds.
3. Cross-check paged queries/exports/permissions with the oracle during saturation, cancellation and expiry; record residual supported limits and reject oversize work instead of silently raising the import ceiling.

Verification: Source/artifact-bound before/after reports from the same frozen profile, raw samples, exact correctness assertions and demonstrated failure detection.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H04.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H04.1: bd-01M4X8MAT0FE5J2NXNWK4ZXTH8
- Q01.2: bd-01M4W5PBV2N5ECB8WMAYB689B6
- W01: bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV
- W02: bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW
- H06.1: bd-01M4X8MB2G63FDYPV1DPX759X1

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H04.2: Measure and remediate the bounded engineering workload
